language_note: STE means Standard Technical English, as specified by the human owner. Records use explicit technical instructions. Source terminology and contextual conditions are retained to preserve meaning.
authority: The source governs. These records do not authorize source changes or replace architectural judgment.
evaluation: Read all applicable rules together. A permitted interaction qualifies the general layer rule. Do not execute an isolated record without its context.
organizational_policy: Workers cannot approve their own departures. Consult docs/governance/roles-and-decisions.md. Protection requires independent permissions and integration checks.
